synonyms: Mahonia moranensis (Hebenstr. & Ludw. ex Schult. & Schult.f.) I.M.Johnst.

en.text: Berberis moranensis is a shrub in the genus Berberis in the family Berberidaceae. Because of its compound leaves, some botanists place it in the genus Mahonia. It is native to forested regions of the mountains of Mexico from Sinaloa and Guanajuato to Oaxaca. Berberis moranensis has thick waxy leaves, yellow flowers, and purple berries. This species is closely related to Berberis pimana J.E. Laferr. & J.S. Marr.

es.text: Berberis moranensis o palo amarillo, palo muerto es una especie de planta con flor en la familia Berberidaceae.
